title: Add log levels across a small repo
prompt: logger.js has no idea of levels, so everything gets printed. Add a `level` option to createLogger (default 'info') so messages below it are dropped (order: debug < info < warn < error), a setLevel(level) method on the logger, and throw an Error for an unknown level in either place. Then make worker.js's logger run at 'warn' and app.js's at process.env.LOG_LEVEL if set, otherwise the default. Keep the message format as it is.
